title: Balance (one asset held by one account)
description: How much of one asset one account holds, as of an observation time. Every figure is an exact decimal string (apps/executor/internal/exchanges/ keeps venue wire decimals as strings end to end; the `used` derived figure is computed with exact decimal subtraction, never float64). Absence rules differ per producer and both are honest: a venue that does not report a basis leaves it NULL (executor AccountEquity: spot_equity/futures_equity/total_equity are *string and 'the venue may not report one basis (honest null)'), while an unreported asset simply does not appear. The repo does NOT have a Balance type in apps/api: the read paths are `ledger.BalanceByAsset` and `treasury.Balances`, both map[string]string keyed on account id.

used.description: Null when the venue does not report a locked figure - never a fabricated 0.

total.description: When both free and used are present this MUST equal their exact sum (decimal.Add), not a re-computed float.
